# appsignal_dashboard_number (Resource)

A single-number tile (Big Number) on an AppSignal dashboard.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "appsignal_dashboard_number" "failed_jobs" {
  app_id       = appsignal_app.web.id
  dashboard_id = appsignal_dashboard.workers.id
  title        = "Failed jobs"
  layout       = { x = 6, y = 0, w = 3, h = 2 }
  metric = {
    name      = "jobs_failed"
    field     = "counter"
    aggregate = "sum"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String)
- `dashboard_id` (String)
- `metric` (Attributes) The metric shown, reduced to one value over the selected time range. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metric))
- `title` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `format` (String) How values are shown: number, percent, duration, throughput, size. Defaults to `number`.
- `format_input` (String) Unit of the reported value when format is `size`: bit, byte, kilobit, kilobyte, megabyte.
- `layout` (Attributes) Position and size on the dashboard grid. Left out, the tile keeps the place AppSignal or the UI gives it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--layout))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--metric"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metric`

Required:

- `aggregate` (String) How the range is reduced: max, min, avg, sum, first, last.
- `field` (String) One of mean, p90, p95, count, gauge, counter.
- `name` (String)

Optional:

- `tags` (Map of String) Tag filters. Values may be `*` to show every value as its own line.


<a id="nestedatt--layout"></a>
### Nested Schema for `layout`

Required:

- `h` (Number)
- `w` (Number)
- `x` (Number)
- `y` (Number)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import appsignal_dashboard_number.failed_jobs <app_id>/<dashboard_id>/<visual_id>
```
